messages:
Keisha: heads up, finance flagged a bunch of overcharges this morning; invoices show ~2x tokens for a few tenants.
AJ: ugh, saw those. any obvious pipeline suspects? routing fallback or dedupe? :eyes: 
Dmitri: initial look — SLO-based routing flapped during a burst and some requests got routed to dedicated pools with a higher price. the final billing events that hit the invoice generator lost `route_id` during aggregation.
Sven: confirmed. aggregator window collapses route metadata if multiple events collapse into one shard. we've been pruning non-essential attrs.
Maya: do we have traces to backtrack which route served a given session?
Dmitri: we have tracing for 72h, but correlator keys differ from billing ids. sample event we receive in billing topic:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "session_id": "s-456",
  "model": "rw-large-v1",
  "tokens": 420
}
```
No `route_id` or `route_trace_id`.
Keisha: finance wants a customer-facing explanation + credits before EOD tomorrow. tickets are piling up.
BillingBot: alert: invoice_delta_spike detected tenant:t-123 amount:$1,450 reason:lost_route_attribute
AJ: quick proposal: (A) start emitting `route_trace_id` (small stable ID) on both streaming and final billing events; (B) aggregator does a light join using `route_trace_id` -> price; (C) console surfaces both "charged model" and "serving route" per invoice line.
Sven: cautious — naive join will blow up state size. instead: emit `route_fingerprint` (8b hash) upstream and keep a TTL key-value for route->price in aggregator; join becomes O(1) and cheaper.
Dmitri: agreed. implementation plan: add `route_fingerprint` to stream protocol, flag-gated behind `route_attr_in_billing`. aggregator reads fingerprint and maps to price table (10m TTL). backfill: run a join against Jaeger traces for 48h to repair recent invoices.
Maya: UX: console should show a tooltip "why billed this way" with: route name, rollout rule id, timestamp, and a link to the rollout rule. Also add an export CSV so support can attach to tickets.
ConsoleUX: I can sketch a small widget. prefer showing both effective price and recommended credit when route mismatch detected.
Keisha: timeline: canary emit today, aggregator join and perf tests by tomorrow morning, backfill for last 48h by EOD tomorrow, comms + credit calc by noon.
AJ: owners: Dmitri -> telemetry emit + canary, Sven -> aggregator mapping + perf, Maya/ConsoleUX -> console surface + export, Keisha -> credit calc + comms.
Dmitri: creating PR now with feature flag + small schema bump. will post link and smoke test results.
Sven: will prototype hashed fingerprint mapping and measure memory. if >2x cost we fall back to sampled retro-credits.
Keisha: node: support playbook for customers: explain reason, show route diff, auto-credit candidate, escalate for manual review.
Maya: also recommend we add an "invoice explanation" row to the tenant billing page — quick diff of model price vs route price.
BillingBot: credit_action_created tenant:t-123 amount:-$1,200 note:"auto-credit for duplicate routing charge"
Keisha: thanks all. :pray: keep updates in this thread.
